summary: This PR adds a pre-tool-use hook for Claude Code that blocks dangerous bash commands (4 file(s) changed, ~363 additions).
risks: Regex patterns may not catch all command obfuscation variants (extra spaces, different flag ordering).
Hardcoded python3 path may fail on systems where python3 is not in PATH.
suggestions: Add more test cases for edge-case obfuscated commands.
Allow the hook to be configured via environment variables.
